channel.title: Road Wars
channel.desc: A rideshare driver and his two passengers are pursued by an unknown vehicle on Long Island; an elderly woman in Serbia is hit by a reversing ambulance; a woman in Arizona is trapped inside a burning pickup; a man in Tennessee takes on a black bear after it targets his car-mounted cooler; a man in New York City confronts a sportscar driver for littering.
